description: This file defines classes and templates related to frame serialization/deserialization, including fixed-size integer classes (SInt24, UInt24), and a templated FrameType class that manages buffer operations, reading, and writing various data types with support for endianness and variable-length encoding. It appears to be part of a core serialization or framing library within the Thunder project.

classes.name: SInt24
classes.description: A class representing a 24-bit signed integer with serialization support.

classes.name: UInt24
classes.description: A class representing a 24-bit unsigned integer with serialization support.

classes.name: FrameType
classes.description: A templated class providing buffer management, serialization, and deserialization of various data types with support for endianness and variable-length encoding.

methods.name: RealSize
methods.description: Template functions to determine the real size of a type or class, considering custom SizeOf static member.
